title: K8s self-heal
description: Hourly autonomous codex session: checks the live aix workloads (pods, cronjobs, site, DB, TLS), fixes easy issues live, and files ticket+PR+notify when a human is needed.
outputContract: One codex session per run. Emits an activity summary; applies safe live fixes directly and verifies them; for human-needed issues files a backlog ticket, opens a merge-ready PR, and pings HITL + Telegram.

acceptanceCriteria: The run inspects pods/deployments, cronjob health, the public site + a DB-backed route, the TLS cert, the aix-db PVC, and logs/events.
Safe fixes are applied live and re-verified (pods Running/Available, endpoint 2xx).
The single-writer invariant is respected (aix-web never scaled past 1; PVCs/data never deleted).
Human-needed issues produce a ticket + PR + HITL/notify rather than a forced change.
